P1.title: AP Biology Cellular Energetics
P1.rationale: The sequence establishes ATP and energy transfer before addressing the electron transport chain, where you feel stuck. It then covers the remaining processes before revisiting each topic through independent practice. You said Electron transport chain was difficult, so it comes earlier after its prerequisites, with extra study time where capacity allows.
